jobs.description:
As a reach truck driver, you are one of the most important links in the Katoen Natie warehouse in Ghent. You are responsible for storing and preparing valuable materials. Using the reach truck, you regularly stock goods on high racks. This requires an eye for detail and safety.

 

Profile

• Physical work doesn't put you off, you like to roll up your sleeves

• You work 60% on the reachtruck and 40% other tasks in the warehouse

• You ideally have extensive experience with the reach truck (at least 1 year); a certificate is a plus, but not a must

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, it is important that you speak and understand Dutch or English or French

• You start in a day shift for training and then fulltime night shift

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 

• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scanners

Quality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processing

Packing & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labeling

Receiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systems

Inventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanliness

Safety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environment

Team Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shifts

Continuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:
Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learn

Enthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!

Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on you

Eye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operations

Physical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shift

Availability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)

Basic Dutch or English communication skills

What Makes You Stand Out:

Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipment

Forklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)

Previous experience in international logistics or port operations

Multilingual skills for our diverse, international workplace

Positive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.

• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.

• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.

• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

As a logistical inventory specialist, you strengthen the team of order pickers at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel working in 2 shifts for €16,3753/hour and meal vouchers.

You fulfill a versatile key position as a logistical inventory specialist, combining the physical order picking of famous toy products with the administrative follow-up of inventory and quality controls. Thanks to your sharp eye and accurate way of working, your contribution as a logistical inventory specialist guarantees a flawless logistical process. 

Ready to take the next step as an order picker? Aply via talentcenter4@randstad.be or 014 24 86 60!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for?

• At least 6 months of demonstrable experience within the logistics sector.
• Practical experience with a hand scanner and administrative follow-up.
• Good command of either the Dutch or English language.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift system.
• Possession of your own transport to reach the location in Geel.
Key responsibilities

• Physically collecting toy goods and orders using a hand scanner.
• Performing thorough quality checks on picked orders from colleague order pickers.
• Monitoring stock levels and supporting warehouse administration.
• Spotting and correcting inventory discrepancies at an early stage.

For the campus of DHL in Bornem, we are looking for order pickers with ETP experience and the necessary ETP certificate. You will work in a dynamic team, where you will work in the alternating shift (6 a.m. to 2 p.m. & 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.). 
 

As an order picker, your duties will include the following tasks: 
 

 
• Collecting/picking orders using a ETP
 
• Applying shipping labels to orders
 
• Loading and unloading trucks, this can be either manually or with an electric transpallet (ETP). 
 
• Taking care of administration: this may involve processing delivery notes 
 
• Quality control of goods dn packaging of goods.
 
• We are looking for order pickers who are keen to prove themselves across the warehouse and in any position. 

As an order picker, you can relate to the following description: 
 

 
• You already have experience in the logistics sector.
 
• You have your own transport to get to the warehouse. (Not accessible by public transport )
 
• You are enthusiastic about taking up a new challenge.
 
• You can perform your tasks accurately and correctly.
 
• A real team player.
 
• You are stress-resistant and always remain customer-friendly under difficult circumstances.
 
• You consider quality of paramount importance.
 
• A good basic knowledge of Dutch or English.

An international Belgian software developer builds its own innovative SaaS solutions for the manufacturing industry. Their software helps manufacturing companies worldwide work smarter, more efficiently, and in a more automated way. Within their Cloud Development team, they are working on a modern, cloud-native solution that is being further built from the ground up using technologies such as .NET and Azure.
In addition, they actively work with AI tools such as Claude Code within an agentic engineering context.
Due to expansion and their continued success, they are currently looking for strong profiles.

Jobomschrijving

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.
In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.
You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar
• Strong professional experience in .NET development
• Interest in AI tools
• You work in English, Dutch is a plus

Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator / Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

At the request of business stakeholders, the candidate analyzes, configures, and codes application software components in accordance with specified changes, standards, and procedures.
Key responsibilities

• Analyze business requirements to define software specifications and perform detailed technical studies

• Configure ERP application packages and develop prototypes

• Develop and test software modules, including unit and integration testing, and resolve defects

• Assemble software components and produce corresponding documentation

• Execute corrective and evolutionary maintenance and manage reusable software components

• Technical analysis

• ERP configuration

• Prototyping

• Unit and integration testing

• Software documentation

• Software maintenance

Qualifications

• Between 3 and 5 years of experience in .NET development

• Between 3 and 5 years of experience with APIs

• Between 3 and 5 years of professional use of English

You will be responsible for the assembly and mounting of products.
You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

You are able to work in a two-shift system and can work both independently and as part of a team.
You already have some initial experience in assembly work.
You are punctual and work accurately.
You speak English or Dutch so that you can communicate with colleagues.

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler (m/f/x) for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

Do you want to be a part of one of the fastest-growing and largest Security Operations Centers in Europe? Do you have a passion for Cyber Security, especially advanced Managed Detection & Response (MDR)? Does Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence and everything related to Cyber Security feel like second nature to you? Are you a Cyber Defender at heart, driven to strengthen the blue team and help organizations that are under attack? If you answered yes to all of these questions, you might be the perfect fit for our CSIRT Analyst role.
 

• You handle security alerts/incidents that have been escalated by the SOC Analysts (Tier 2)
• You conduct DFIR assignments, including DFIR readiness assessments
• You participate in the weekly Threat Hunting duty to proactively chase threats through novel Tools, Techniques & Procedures (TTPs)
• You will perform compromise assessments to identify potential compromises and their scope
• You collect Threat Intelligence (IOCs and TTPs)
• You will contribute to Detection Engineering in SIEM, xDR, …
• Together with the Red Team you will do Purple Teaming exercises to test and improve defenses
• You contribute to the creation of playbooks in SOAR
• You will co-write processes and procedures related to DFIR, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, …
• You will be part of our Incident Response on call service.

Profile

• You have at least 3-5 years of experience in a similar position
• You have a bachelor or master degree or equivalent through experience
• You are able to perform forensically sound acquisition, parsing and analysis of disk, memory images, forensic artifacts and logs in order to rebuild the timeline of events for a cybersecurity incident. Extensive hands-on experience in this domain of expertise is mandatory
• You have experience and/or interest in working with the following MDR tools: EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon, MS Defender for Endpoint, Sentinel One, ...), NDR (Vectra, Darktrace, ...), xDR (CrowdStrike Identity Protection, MS Defender for Office/Clouds Apps/Identity/...)
• As an analyst or engineer, you already have a good knowledge of Security Monitoring with SIEM technologies
• You are passionate about the following security capabilities: Security Monitoring, Digital Forensics, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, ...
• You have a hands-on and proactive mindset with a 'can do' mentality
• You speak and write English fluently.

jobs.occupation: Junior IT Support -  Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technology and eager to kick-start your career in IT support? We are looking for a Junior IT Support Engineer to join a dynamic international environment in the heart of Brussels.

As part of the IT team, you will be the first point of contact for end users and help ensure a smooth and efficient IT experience across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first-line IT support to employees.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, and Microsoft 365 issues.
• Managing incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
• Preparing and configuring laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.
• Assisting with onboarding and offboarding activities.
• Escalating complex issues when necessary and following up to resolution.
• Delivering excellent customer service to users at all levels of the business.

Profile

• A degree in IT or a first experience/internship in IT support.
• Basic knowledge of Windows environments and Microsoft 365.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent French and a good level of English. Dutch is a plus.
• A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and strong customer-service mindset.
• Team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• Great level of English (fluent speaker)

Responsibilities

• Drive the functional build-out of the SAP CDC application and its complex interfaces within the system landscape.
• Identify and translate business requirements into functional specifications and technical implementations.
• Lead hands-on implementation of B2C and B2B Customer Identity & Access Management solutions.
• Collaborate with integration teams to deliver required interfaces between SAP and non-SAP environments.
• Manage organizational workspace settings, including delegated user administration and approval workflows.
• Maintain and optimize screensets, UI builder configurations, and identity query tools.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP CDC and CIAM.
• You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP CRM.
• You possess expertise in B2B and B2C identity management, including Screensets and UI Builder.
• You have experience working with Identity Query Tool, APIs, and Site creation.
• You're skilled in User Management, Authorizations, and Master Data Management.
• You possess strong analytical skills to translate functional requirements into technical specifications.
• You're an enthusiastic team player with a problem-solving mindset and strong operational practices.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English at a minimum CEFR level C1.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in SAP S/4HANA and SAP CPI integrations.
• Familiarity with GDPR processes within SAP CDC.
• Experience with Adobe marketing platforms and Agile methodologies.
• Knowledge of ServiceNow and Jira.
• Experience working in a transport or logistics context.
